errors.evidence: The color for „Акции на АДСИЦ“ is described as brown/reddish, but the figure and atom checklist indicate it should be dark red (тъмно червено).
The description states approximately 1550 млн. лв. for 2013, but the figure shows a value closer to 1400–1450 млн. лв.
The description states approximately 330–350 млн. лв. for 2019, but the figure shows a value slightly below 400 млн. лв.
The description does not explicitly mention the color for „Други“ (light red/sветло червено) as indicated in the atom checklist.
The description incorrectly implies that „Акции (без АДСИЦ)“ is always the base segment, but this is not explicitly stated or emphasized in the figure.
